verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows Stripe Terminal is API-based and even has an MCP server for AI agents to call the Stripe API, but nothing describes issuing scoped or least-privilege API keys/credentials specifically for agent use — no restricted-key generation, permission-scoping UI, or agent-specific credential mechanism is mentioned. Since Terminal exposes a real API surface, this axis is applicable, but absence of evidence means it cannot be credited as delivered.
